families_note: All four lanes across both rounds were gemini (3.1-pro-high, 3.8-flash-high). No claude-family lane ran: this is a docs-only report whose claims are greps and file reads, and every gemini lane MEASURED (command/output pairs in its findings, four sampled dead fields re-read, counts re-run). S5 asks for two families where a lane must EXECUTE to see the defect; here none had to. Recorded, not hidden.

findings: '11' computed-but-unexposed was a hits[:400] cap over 1896 fields; HanseiReport derives Debug only and CacheStats Debug+Clone, so the serde exemption was dodging
line 25 overstated: the step is named 'Check for known vulnerabilities', it runs, its exit is swallowed
scope paragraph said probes 3 and 5 covered the Makefile; probe 3 was workflows only; Makefile carries 34 '|| true'
the correction claimed the roadmap row's wording was 'mirrored here' while roadmap.yaml:3370 still said 'NAMED as the thorough check is the disabled one' — only the row title was precise
confirmed_by_measurement: 4 of the 56 AUDIT-3 fields: 0 reads in src/, no Serialize derive
scripts/release-policy.sh:156 is a documented best-effort fallback, not a gate

self_correction: Three review rounds, three defects, all in the author's own text about measurement: a truncation reported as a count, a name-and-status overstatement, and a claim that text had been mirrored when it had not. Each was falsified by one grep. The report now carries all three as visible corrections rather than silent rewrites.
residuals: AUDIT-3 (56 dead fields) and AUDIT-4 (make test swallows cargo test failures) are minted, not fixed
the AUDIT-1 fix itself (remove '|| true' from security.yml:26, decide whether step 26 is wanted) is the roadmap row's work, not this report's
